purpose: Design spec for document search and DLID resolution: pre-search freshness judgment, search result contract, search AI role, ToC copy contents, and the read-only resolve-dlid behavior.
summary: Pre-search judgment: no confirmed ToC, rebuild not needed, rebuild needed, or undeterminable
User choice between rebuilding before search and searching the existing version, with rebuild scale shown
Undeterminable state treated as a failure that stops search; no silent fallback to old version
Search result contract: document ID, recorded path, reason, section, key, ToC version, freshness
Search AI reads all entries of the ToC copy and prioritizes avoiding false negatives
ToC copy contents: document info and section headings, without paths, hashes, references, or check results
Worker must not invent IDs, correct paths, or change ToC and management state
resolve-dlid resolves DLIDs from recorded paths and verifies against current files
Resolution outcomes: resolved, not at recorded path, no record; content hash attached from records only
Resolution is read-only and does not write ToC, management state, or index target documents
tasks: Implementing document search skill and scripts
Designing the search AI agent prompt and input
Handling stale or rebuild-needed ToC in search
Writing tests for search and DLID resolution
